metadata.question: Was the surface temperature at (63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525) higher than Grindavik on January 16, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare surface temperature at a specific point (63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525) vs Grindavik, Iceland - Date: January 16, 2024 - Will use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) or Landsat 8/9 with thermal bands - Grindavik is in Iceland, coordinates approximately (63.84, -22.43) - very close to the given point - The question point seems to be near/in Grindavik itself 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds for accurate temperature readings - Use QA bands to filter poor quality pixels 3. Logic: - Get temperature at point 1: (63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525) - Get temperature at Grindavik center: approximately (63.84, -22.43) - Compare: if temp1 > temp2 → A, else → B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([63.8577134531586, -22.413665983340525]); const grindavik = ee.Geometry.Point([63.84, -22.43]); // Grindavik center const startDate = '2024-01-16'; const endDate = '2024-01-17'; try { // 2. Get MODIS LST data (Terra) let lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point1) .select('LST_Day_1km'); let collectionSize = await lstCollection.size().getInfo(); // Fallback to Aqua MODIS if Terra has no data if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No Terra MODIS data, trying Aqua MODIS..."); lstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(point1) .select('LST_Day_1km'); collectionSize = await lstCollection.size().getInfo(); } if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS data found for Jan 16, 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`Found ${collectionSize} MODIS image(s)`); // 3. Get the image and convert to Celsius (MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02) const lstImage = lstCollection.mean(); const lstCelsius = lstImage.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 4. Sample at both points const temp1Result = await lstCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const temp2Result = await lstCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: grindavik, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const temp1 = temp1Result.LST_Day_1km; const temp2 = temp2Result.LST_Day_1km; // 5. Check for valid data if (temp1 === null || temp2 === null || isNaN(temp1) || isNaN(temp2)) { console.log(`Temp at point1: ${temp1}, Temp at Grindavik: ${temp2}`); console.log("Invalid temperature data (null or NaN)."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Sanity check for reasonable temperature range if (temp1 < -100 || temp1 > 100 || temp2 < -100 || temp2 > 100) { console.log(`Unrealistic temperatures: ${temp1}C, ${temp2}C`); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Temperature at (63.858, -22.414): ${temp1.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Temperature at Grindavik center: ${temp2.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 6. Compare and answer if (temp1 > temp2) { console.log(`${temp1.toFixed(2)} > ${temp2.toFixed(2)}: Point 1 is warmer`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`${temp1.toFixed(2)} <= ${temp2.toFixed(2)}: Point 1 is not warmer`); console.log("B"); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
